couch.label: Couch
couch.desc_card: Three-seater sofas and traditional couches up to 84″.
couch.meta: {city} couch & sofa removal with upfront online pricing from ${price}. Same-day & next-day pickup across {city} and the {state} metro area. Donation routing first.
couch.hero_sub: Across {city} and the surrounding {state} area. Independent local Loaders, upfront pricing, donation routing first. Same-day pickup available for most ZIPs when you book before noon.
couch.intro: A standard three-seater is the single most common pickup we run in {city}. Most fit through a standard doorway without disassembly, which is why couch removal starts at our base rate — ${price} in {city}, stairs included.
couch.difficulty: Standard couches are usually a two-person carry. The tight spot in {city} homes is almost always the turn at the bottom of a stairwell or a narrow apartment corridor, not the couch itself.
couch.faq_cost: Couch removal in {city} starts at ${price} for a standard three-seater sofa. Final pricing depends on your exact ZIP and floor access. Disassembly and stairs are always included — there are no per-flight surcharges.
couch.faq_special: A standard couch rarely needs disassembly. If your sofa won't clear a doorway or a stairwell turn, the assigned Loader will remove the legs or back panel on site at no extra charge.
couch.faq_disposal: Couches in donatable condition are routed to local {state} charity partners first. Frames that can't be donated go to material recovery facilities — hardwood, steel springs, and foam are separated for recycling.

sectional.label: Sectional
sectional.meta: {city} sectional sofa removal from ${price}. L-shape, U-shape, and modular sectionals — disassembly and stairs included. Same-day pickup across {city}, {state}.
sectional.hero_sub: L-shape, U-shape, chaise, and modular sectionals across {city}. Multi-piece disassembly is included in the price, not billed as an extra.
sectional.intro: Sectionals price higher than a standard couch because they're a multi-piece carry — usually two to five sections, often with a hidden bracket system. {city} pricing starts at ${price} and covers separating the sections on site.
sectional.difficulty: The failure point on a sectional is the connector hardware. Older modular frames use metal interlocks that seize; the assigned Loader carries the tools to break them apart rather than forcing the piece through a doorway.
sectional.faq_cost: Sectional removal in {city} starts at ${price}. That covers a standard two- to three-piece sectional. Larger U-shape and five-piece modular configurations are priced at booking once you select the piece count.
sectional.faq_special: Yes — disassembly is included. Sections are separated at the connector brackets, and chaise or console modules are pulled independently. You don't need to take anything apart before the Loader arrives.
sectional.faq_disposal: Intact sectionals in good condition are strong donation candidates and go to local {state} partners first. Mixed-material sectionals are broken down at material recovery facilities so the steel frame and foam are recovered separately.

sleeper-sofa.label: Sleeper Sofa
sleeper-sofa.meta: {city} sleeper sofa & pull-out couch removal from ${price}. Steel fold-out mechanisms handled — stairs included. Same-day pickup across {city}, {state}.
sleeper-sofa.hero_sub: Pull-outs, hide-a-beds, and convertible sofa beds across {city}. The steel mechanism is the heavy part — it's priced in, not surcharged.
sleeper-sofa.intro: A sleeper sofa weighs roughly double a standard couch of the same footprint because of the folding steel bed frame and mattress inside. {city} pricing starts at ${price} and accounts for the extra lift.
sleeper-sofa.difficulty: Sleeper sofas are the most common cause of a stuck stairwell. The mechanism can shift mid-carry if it isn't strapped, so Loaders secure the fold-out closed before the piece leaves the room.
sleeper-sofa.faq_cost: Sleeper sofa removal in {city} starts at ${price} — higher than a standard couch because the internal steel bed frame roughly doubles the weight. Stairs and the mattress inside are included.
sleeper-sofa.faq_special: Leave the bed folded in and latched if it will latch. If the mechanism is broken and won't close, note it at booking so the assigned Loader brings straps — there's no extra charge for it.
sleeper-sofa.faq_disposal: Working sleeper sofas are in high demand at {state} donation partners. When one can't be donated, the steel fold-out mechanism is separated as scrap metal and the mattress is routed to a mattress recycler where one operates locally.

loveseat.label: Loveseat
loveseat.meta: {city} loveseat & two-seater sofa removal from ${price}. The lowest-cost sofa pickup we run — stairs included. Same-day service across {city}, {state}.
loveseat.hero_sub: Two-seaters, settees, and compact apartment sofas across {city}. The smallest footprint we pick up, and the cheapest.
loveseat.intro: A loveseat is the lowest-priced sofa pickup on the platform — ${price} in {city}. Under 60″ and light enough that access is rarely the constraint, which is what keeps the rate below a full couch.
loveseat.difficulty: Loveseats clear most doorways and elevators without disassembly. If you're in a {city} walk-up, this is the one piece that almost never gets stuck.
loveseat.faq_cost: Loveseat removal in {city} starts at ${price} — the lowest sofa rate we offer, since a two-seater is lighter and clears standard doorways without disassembly.
loveseat.faq_special: Rarely. A loveseat fits through a 30″ doorway in most orientations. If yours has a fixed sleeper mechanism inside, book it as a sleeper sofa instead so the weight is priced correctly.
loveseat.faq_disposal: Loveseats are among the easiest pieces to place with {state} charity partners — they fit small apartments, so demand is steady. Non-donatable frames are recycled for hardwood and foam.

recliner.label: Recliner
recliner.desc_card: Manual, power, lift chairs, massage chairs.
recliner.meta: {city} recliner removal from ${price} — manual, power, lift, and massage chairs. Motors and batteries recycled. Same-day pickup across {city}, {state}.
recliner.hero_sub: Manual recliners, power units, medical lift chairs, and massage chairs across {city}. Motors and control boxes are separated for recycling.
recliner.intro: Recliners are compact but dense — a power unit carries a motor, transformer, and sometimes a battery backup. {city} pricing starts at ${price} and includes recycling the electrical components.
recliner.difficulty: Recliner mechanisms pinch. Loaders strap the footrest closed before lifting, which is also why we ask you to unplug a power unit and coil the cord before the pickup window.
recliner.faq_cost: Recliner removal in {city} starts at ${price}, the same as a standard couch — recliners are smaller but much denser, and power units carry motors and transformers that need separate handling.
recliner.faq_special: Unplug power recliners and coil the cord before the window. Medical lift chairs with battery backups should be noted at booking so the battery is pulled and recycled separately.
recliner.faq_disposal: Working lift chairs and recliners are routed to {state} medical-equipment and furniture charities first. On non-donatable units the motor, transformer, and any battery are removed for e-waste recycling before the frame is processed.

futon.label: Futon
futon.desc_card: Wood and metal frames, futon mattresses, daybeds.
futon.meta: {city} futon removal from ${price} — frame and mattress taken together. Wood or metal frames, stairs included. Same-day pickup across {city}, {state}.
futon.hero_sub: Wood and metal futon frames, futon mattresses, and daybeds across {city}. Frame and mattress go together at one price.
futon.intro: Futon pricing in {city} starts at ${price} and covers both the frame and the mattress as a single pickup — they aren't billed as two items.
futon.difficulty: Futon frames come apart faster than any other piece we handle, which helps in tight {city} stairwells. The mattress is the awkward half — dense cotton fill is heavier than it looks.
futon.faq_cost: Futon removal in {city} starts at ${price} and includes both the frame and the mattress. You aren't charged separately for the two halves.
futon.faq_special: No prep needed. Wood and metal futon frames disassemble on site in a few minutes, which is often the easiest way out of a narrow {city} stairwell.
futon.faq_disposal: Futon frames are donated when the hardware is intact. Cotton-fill futon mattresses are difficult to donate for hygiene reasons and are routed to material recovery instead, where the fill and frame are separated.
